title: config.changed
description: A config version became a tenant's active configuration (C16 §6). Published by the tenancy module on NATS subject evt.config.changed (version 1). Consumers reload cached configuration; the catalogue rebuilds its dictionary (Engineering Decisions D5). This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. New fields are additive only.

tenant.description: Tenant code (the same value as X-Tenant-Id)

version.description: The activated config version; equal to the rules_version of rule sets read from it
